verdict.rationale: Pilot is an accounting and bookkeeping service, so agent-driven ledger anomaly detection is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence shows only on-demand AI Q&A about past transactions and real-time expense tracking marketed as 'find the $2,000/month you didn't know you were wasting.' Nothing documents an agent that continuously monitors the ledger, or that flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions before the close. These are adjacent features, and the close itself is handled by human accountants.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
